         1                      P R O C E E D I N G S.

         2                      ACTING PRESIDENT DALY:  The

         3       Senate will come to order.  We will now have the

         4       Pledge of Allegiance.

         5                      (Whereupon, the Senate joined in

         7                      ACTING PRESIDENT DALY:  I would

         8       like to now introduce our visiting clergy today,

         9       Reverend Vincent Gordon from the Bethany Chapel

        10       in Brooklyn, to say the prayer.

        11                      May we bow our heads in a moment

        12       of silence.

        13                      REVEREND VINCENT GORDON: Let us

        14       pray.

        15                      Our God and our father in heaven,

        16       we come to Thee this afternoon in the precious

        17       name of Thy son, the Lord Jesus Christ, our

        18       Savior.

        19                      We want to pour out our hearts in

        20       gratitude and thanksgivings unto Thee for Thy

        21       love and Thy grace and for all kindness that

        22       Thou has shown and is showing to us.

        23                      We thank Thee for this moment











                                                             
1109

         1       that Thou has brought these great men and women

         2       together again to discuss matters concerning the

         3       people whom Thou has committed to their trust.

         4       We thank Thee for their labor of love and their

         5       interest and concern.

         6                      Today, our God, we do pray that

         7       Thou sparkle their hearts and burden their

         8       hearts with love and compassion for those of us

         9       whom Thou has committed unto them.

        10                      We pray, our God, that the Holy

        11       Spirit will motivate their thoughts and the

        12       Spirit of God will guide their expressions and

        13       grant that everything will be controlled by

        14       Thyself, and that the very outcome of this

        15       session this evening, whatever may be

        16       determined, will be that to which Thou hast

        17       already set the seal of Thine own divine

        18       approval.

        19                      We pray for them that Thou bless

        20       them, that Thou prosper them and do keep them

        21       safely and preserve them from harm and dangers

        22       and their families, too.

        23                      Grant, our father, that they'll











                                                             
1110

         1       continue to discharge the responsibility that

         2       Thou hast committed to their trust for the good

         3       and welfare of the people whom Thou hast

         4       committed unto them.

         5                      We are inviting Thy presence with

         6       us now in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ and

         7       for His sake.

         8                      Amen.
